non_blocking_observations.observation: Re-opening an already-open `StimulationActionPath` via the public `open()` clears `held_leases_` (stimulation_actions.cpp:362) without releasing the corresponding registry leases. A later emulation for the same endpoint generation is then permanently `LeaseConflict` because the orphan `Active` lease is no longer tracked by the path, and repeated re-open cycles could consume the bounded registry capacity.
non_blocking_observations.assessment: Not reachable through the declared single-open-per-path lifetime (unit-specifications.md:146); the accepted design does not define re-open lease semantics. Recorded for the bounded-resource traceability of `XCOM-DU-018`.

non_blocking_observations.observation: `drain`/`close` on a non-active, non-terminal (`declared`/`armed`) state cancel every pending action but leave the lease table unchanged (stimulation_actions.cpp:693-701, :781-789), which matches detailed-design.md:215-218 but is not stated in the public `close` header comment (stimulation_actions.hpp:1013) that generically says "releases every held lease".
non_blocking_observations.assessment: Design-consistent and fail-closed; only a minor header/design wording gap, not a behavioural defect.

non_blocking_observations.observation: `held_leases_` is an unbounded `std::vector` that grows on every successful `acquire` and is only cleared by the path's own `release_all_locked`/`expire_all_locked`; external release of a path-owned lease followed by re-acquisition of the same endpoint generation could append a duplicate `HeldLease`.
non_blocking_observations.assessment: Not reachable through the action path's own API (`execute` never releases). Recorded for the bounded-resource traceability of `XCOM-DU-018`.

non_blocking_observations.observation: `EmissionAttempt.emission` defaults to `EmissionStatus::Delivered` and `execute` copies it into `ActionDiagnostic.emission_status` even when the journal fails before invoking the seam (for example a `WriteFailed` intent append), so the diagnostic can read `Delivered` while `status == JournalFailed`.
non_blocking_observations.assessment: The header documents `emission_status` as meaningful only when a callback ran, and `status`/`journal_status` are authoritative. No fail-closed impact; a discriminating default would be clearer.

non_blocking_observations.observation: `docs/engineering/xcom/t028/implementation.md` §7 records the IR2 and IR4 repair passes (§7.9, §7.10) but has no narrative entry for the IR5 repair. The corrected drain/close completion semantics are nevertheless fully captured in the authoritative work products: `detailed-design.md` §4.4 step 5 and §5.5, `verification-plan.md` CHK-16, and `unit-specifications.md` T28-TS-013/T28-TS-014, and are exercised by the closure tests.
non_blocking_observations.assessment: The requirement, design, verification, and unit work products are consistent with the code and tests, so traceability is intact; this is a narrative-completeness gap in one work product, not a behavioural or traceability defect. Recorded for work-product maintenance. A future pass may add an IR5 repair-log entry to implementation.md §7.

summary: Verdict pass. The repaired candidate is well-scoped, additive, offline, deterministic, and linear over baseline c518c5e4fcb2055666db25cb62018769e7f56ae4; the deterministic verify gate reports changed_paths 22 and ctest:367, the five t028-* suites run 22/22, the four register validators and the delivery-inputs audit pass, and the inherited provenance hashes are content-correct (`CMakeLists.txt` 74b538b8...e22fe and `links.json` e3c5ba9c...dbb3). The three prior review-revision-5 findings are independently confirmed closed by code, documentation, and dedicated closure tests, and were re-challenged by an independent out-of-repo probe: T028-IR5-F01 (drain now returns `EvidenceIncomplete` for a durable intent lacking a durable outcome; probe P1), T028-IR5-F02 (`close` reports each distinct orphan once; probes P2/P3), and T028-IR5-F03 (CHK-04 discovery is now 22, matching `ctest -N -L t028`). No open finding remains; the prior review-revision-2 and review-revision-4 completion findings also remain closed. This review is read-only and does not accept or integrate the candidate; the generated package manifest is regenerated by the downstream package node, and external review and user acceptance remain deferred until the backlog completes. Recommended model and reasoning effort for the next step: deepseek-v4-flash at high reasoning effort for the deterministic `package` gate, which is mechanical; external review and user acceptance remain separate, and T028 stays active in the ordered backlog.
